entities.summary: Georg Carabelli, Edler von Lunkaszprie was a prominent Hungarian dentist and professor of dental surgery in Vienna. He held a minor noble rank, which referenced the town of Lunkaszprie. Born in the late 18th century, Carabelli's contributions to dentistry were marked by his innovative techniques and publications. He was a member of the Hungarian Academy of Sciences and was recognized for his work in the field of dental surgery. Carabelli's legacy continued through his students and colleagues, who built upon his discoveries. His impact on the field of dentistry can still be seen today, with many institutions and organizations continuing to honor his memory. Georg Carabelli's life was marked by both personal and professional achievements, leaving a lasting impact on the world of dentistry. His story is a testament to the power of human ingenuity and perseverance.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Georg Carabelli's work in dental surgery had a significant impact on the development of the field, influencing the establishment of the Vienna University of Medicine and the Austrian Empire's policies on dental surgery. He was a member of the Hungarian Academy of Sciences and held a noble rank in the town of Lunkaszprie, which is located in Hungary.
